name: Altoids Curiously Strong Peppermints
whyItWorks: Natural peppermint oil has clinically demonstrated antispasmodic properties on gastrointestinal smooth muscle, helping to alleviate painful intestinal cramping and trapped gas.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Dissolve 1 mint on the tongue after a meal to reduce postprandial intestinal spasms.
watchOuts: Peppermint relaxes the lower esophageal sphincter; avoid if you suffer from severe GERD or acid reflux.
